hubs.title: Library
hubs.body: Every game I have played, on the shelf. Filter by genre, hover a cover for the note I wrote about it, click through to the store. Includes the Watch Dogs games — the reason this whole half of the site exists.

hubs.title: Gallery
hubs.body: Nature and objects, edited on my own time. Placeholder tiles for now — real files land by dropping them into the gallery folder and editing one JSON line.

hubs.title: Projects
hubs.body: Tools, games and experiments. Same page on both sides of the doorway; it just wears a different skin depending on which way you walked in.

hubs.title: Transmissions
hubs.body: Notes on systems, models and Linux desktops. Also cross-listed on the professional side — the writing does not care which door you came through.

about: The professional half has the CV, the papers and the contact button. This half has the covers, the camera roll and a prompt. Both are the same person: I build AI that survives contact with real systems, then go shoot photographs of oil palm plantations and eat noodles at 2am.

reading.title: On the desk
reading.body: Books on technology, science and philosophy, mostly second-hand, mostly mid-read.
